same 3–10m patch footprint across ≥2 years plus stable island parent feature id

independently measured physical legacy change before next season, not just a previous nest label
new nest site and banded origin within spatial ring, avoiding original-site reuse misclassification

prespecified falsification test vs static site-quality and success-conditioned public information
